# according to

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/accordingTo>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/standpoint`](../../slices/standpoint.md)

The standpoint / frame within which the annotated statement is asserted true — *according to whom*. DISTINCT from [`gmeow:wasAttributedTo`](gmeow-wasAttributedTo.md) (which source RECORDED the claim) and [`gmeow:confidence`](gmeow-confidence.md) (how sure we are); a claim may carry all three with no inferential bridge among them. Its value is a [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) (a polity, community, or organization IRI) or a [`gmeow:Standpoint`](../classes/gmeow-Standpoint.md) individual (a frame that needs its own identity). When a statement is promoted to a reified [`gmeow:Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md), [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) becomes the [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) of the relator (vantage ⊑ [`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) — documented, not axiomatised, because [`accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) is an AnnotationProperty and vantage is an ObjectProperty). Standpoint-TIME — when the frame held this position — rides [`gmeow:validFrom`](gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) on the same statement in the light case, or a reified [`gmeow:StandpointTenure`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointTenure.md) when the adoption / withdrawal is itself the fact of interest. The range is intentionally open. An unindexed statement is held according to [`gmeow:universalStandpoint`](../individuals/gmeow-universalStandpoint.md) (the uncontested global facts).

## Structure

**Property shape:** annotation property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
